title: orchis incarnata var. fraasii
intro: Orchis incarnata var. fraasii, commonly known as the Fraas' Orchid, is a rare and unique species of orchid found in specific regions. It is a type of terrestrial orchid that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. This plant has been reported to possess various health benefits, including its potential use in treating respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The Fraas' Orchid contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which exhibit therapeutic actions like antimicrobial, antioxidant, and antitumor activities.
